Scene.title: A Crack in the Reset
Scene.line: Angela enters Cale's chamber during the preparation phase.
She admits that the Manager has reset the day again.
Cale asks what Ayin and the Eye of the City actually intend to accomplish.

Scene.title: The Truth
Scene.line: On the fiftieth day, the Light will spread through the City.
When the Light ends, the Corporation facilities will collapse or be sealed.
The people living around the branches of the Corporation will be abandoned.

Scene.title: The Contract
Scene.line: Cale contacts the God of Death, the God of the Sun, and the God of Balance.
They must open portals above every branch and evacuate everyone on the fiftieth day.
The God of Death seals the contract.
